name: Fungal Connections
source:
Oliwia wants to leave her home and become a full-fledged merchant. She encounters a mysterious being in the woods that may change her life in an expanding way!

Will it change her life forever?

translation:
奥利维亚想离开家，成为一名成熟的商人。她在树林里遇到了一个神秘的存在，这可能会极大地改变她的生活！

这会永远改变她的生活吗？
